decisions.reason: A door lever handle family sits at the core of the firm's decades of handle design and in-house metal engineering, so it can readily interpret early results and refine the range.
Mitred lever handles extend the firm's existing proprietary finishing and fabrication know-how, keeping the product close to its related knowledge base.
A multifunctional lever handle builds on the firm's ergonomic and barrier-free expertise, which fits its strategic direction and its ability to learn and improve.
A single lever handle model is a direct application of core competencies, though its modest web presence makes it a slightly weaker candidate than the families.
The award-winning collection has its own page and lies squarely within the firm's design and engineering knowledge, giving strong grounds to keep and develop it.
A patinated bronze finish draws on the firm's proprietary finishing and high-grade metals expertise, making it an easily absorbed range extension.
